elements_selected.content: Create src/view/ module (distinct from existing src/tui/). Includes: mod.rs declaring the module; app.rs with ViewApp struct holding state (current_page, scroll_offset, nav_history, context_mode, focus_state); event.rs with the crossterm event loop; terminal.rs with enter_alternate_screen / restore_terminal helpers using crossterm. Wire the module into src/lib.rs and src/main.rs. ratatui + crossterm are already in Cargo.toml (from IMPL-TUI); no new Cargo.toml changes required.
